section.heading: ## Proteinjs UI — the windowed list holds its rows, the browser holds the list’s place: Home’s back-to-top reaches the top in one tap (row 3435)
section.text:
- Home’s back-to-top reaches the top in one tap. On iOS 27 the browser was holding the list’s rows in place while the list held them too, and the browser’s correction stopped the scroll partway up; the list now holds its rows alone, and the browser goes on holding the list’s place under what stands above it.
- For the same reason a hard flick down Home is no longer told it has stopped while it is still moving.
smoke: - HOME’S BACK-TO-TOP, on test on the phone: scroll down Home a few screens, let it stop, and tap the up arrow once — it runs all the way to the top, the greeting in view and the arrow gone.
- HOME’S FLICK, on test on the phone: flick down Home once, hard, and let go — it keeps going until it slows down by itself.
